_comment: Discoverable capability descriptor for the dedicated service-email (Gmail) mailbox. FR-20260808-dedicated-service-email. Any workspace agent or project may read this file (or call integrations.gmail.describe_capability()) to learn what the mailbox can do and how it is governed.
name: dedicated-service-email
summary: Sequestered service mailbox for the workspace ecosystem: autonomous service sign-ups, operator-gated outbound notifications (compose a local draft, deliver only on explicit operator approval), and confirmation-email reading — governed by an action-scoped policy.
outbound_default: disabled by default (allow_outbound=false); even when enabled, delivery requires an explicit operator_approved=True argument

outbound_api.create_draft: Compose and validate a local EmailDraft (recipient syntax + CR/LF header-injection rejection). No network I/O; delivers nothing.
outbound_api.send_draft: Deliver a draft. Sends only when operator_approved is exactly True; any other value is refused with no Gmail API call.
outbound_api.send_message: Convenience wrapper that stages a draft then delivers under the same operator approval gate; never delivers directly from a bare agent call.
outbound_api.connectivity_test: Rides the same operator-gated draft path; sends only with an explicit test-only operator_approved=True.

residual_risk: The mailbox has full-inbox visibility. Sensitive-content filtering (financial/PII/medical heuristics) is best-effort pattern matching applied before any message body is returned to an agent; it can miss novel or obfuscated sensitive content (false negatives) and may over-redact benign text (false positives). Treat the mailbox as a low-trust, service-only inbox: never route health, financial, or identity-critical mail here, and always re-review before forwarding externally.
setup_requirements: Human creates the Gmail account out-of-band (never by an agent).

Human completes OAuth consent out-of-band and stores the base64 authorized-user token in the GMAIL_SERVICE_TOKEN system environment variable. The local, human-only helper tools/gmail_oauth_bootstrap.py mints this token: it reads a Desktop OAuth client from --client-json or the GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET env vars, requests only the gmail.readonly + gmail.send scopes, runs the consent flow, and transfers the token via --set-user-env or --clipboard without printing or writing it. Agents must never run this tool.
Set GMAIL_SERVICE_ADDRESS to the mailbox address.
Connectivity-test recipient is supplied at run time only and is never stored.
